assumptions.choice: Position size is calculated as 2% of current broker portfolio value divided by the current close.
assumptions.reason: The specification requires a fixed 2% of capital per trade but does not define capital; current portfolio value is the literal available capital measure in the single-strategy environment.

assumptions.choice: A long upper-band touch uses High >= upper band; a short lower-band touch uses Low <= lower band.
assumptions.reason: OHLC bars can establish an intrabar touch only through High and Low.

assumptions.choice: Stop-loss and take-profit orders are submitted after entry fills, using the Bollinger Band values on that fill notification bar.
assumptions.reason: The specification gives band-based protective levels but does not state that existing orders should be repriced as the bands move.

assumptions.choice: A signal-based exit cancels outstanding protective orders before submitting self.close().
assumptions.reason: This prevents protective orders from opening a reverse position after the specified position has been closed.
